summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress on its ongoing share buyback program originally announced on October 30, 2025, with a EUR 30 million authorization. The filing details the repurchase of 74,816 shares on Nasdaq from May 11–15, 2026, at an average price of EUR 4.77 per share for EUR 356,986. Since program start on January 26, 2026, 748,789 shares have been bought back for EUR 3,399,426, representing 1.3% of outstanding shares. This is a routine capital return update, not a formal tender offer or special situation. The program continues under a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary.
